text.text_excerpt: Had the best time here! It is a wonderful space with a rooftop area. This space is also available for rent for events. We came in and sat wherever we wanted. The band was setting up while we arrived. They usually have music starting at 6 PM or some type of entertainment. We started off with some refreshing cocktails. I love the Beet It Margarita. It was unique yet yummy. We also had Best Fronds too. I think that's the drink's name. It was so good. It was like a pina colada but 10000 times better. We got some apps like the crab cakes, broccoli and fried cauliflower. DO NOT SKIP ON THE CRAB CAKES. So amazing. I'm not a big fan of crabs but these are lightly fried with a fresh citrus salad. ...

The food here is great! Live music certain nights, with an extended Happy Hour, free street parking, and a roof top for nice weather. Love this place and highly recommend to anyone. They have one of the best happy hours for options, prices, and length of time. They have the best vegan, vegetarian, GF, etc. menu I've seen in a while - for the best prices. The bartenders are always super sweet, and the place is so clean. I can't recommend Capulet enough. The food is super tasty; even if you're not that hungry, order something anyway. A quick search revealed this place and, although I had heard something about it, I didn't know much when I decided to have lunch here. As I said it was late, so the huge space was mostly empty except for a few people enjoying some drinks at the bar. This is a "walk up and order" type of place, so after looking over the menu, I decided on a chicken salad sandwich.
